cli.usage:
Usage: apps [command]

  apps                 Interactive panel
  apps run <name>      Launch an app
  apps new [name]      Create an app from a template
  apps install <src>   Install from GitHub (user/repo or URL)
  apps adopt <path>    Adopt an existing repo
  apps register <cmd>  Register a command already installed on the PC
  apps remove <name>   Remove an app
  apps list            List installed apps

Env vars: APPS_HOME (apps folder, default ~/apps), APPS_LANG (es|en), APPS_AI (default AI agent)
